feedback: This candidate has not yet been raced, so no telemetry data is available to confirm the effects of the current parameters. The controller uses a base_speed of 1.4, slightly reduced to improve stability and reduce aggressive driving. The kd gain is increased to 3.5 to enhance damping of oscillations, while kp remains at 7 and ki at 0.35 to balance responsiveness and integral correction. Sensor weights are adjusted to [-1.0, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.0], increasing the influence of the inner sensors to potentially improve steering precision. The geometry remains unchanged, which is reasonable given no reported issues. I recommend racing this candidate unchanged to obtain telemetry data, as it represents a reasonable balance of speed and stability improvements based on prior feedback and is likely better than previous unscored candidates. After racing, further refinements can be made based on actual performance data.
